dedupe_keys.name: sintef four area test network for reliability studies

description: The four-area test network is a synthetic transmission test system that SINTEF Energy Research has used in several power system reliability publications. Version 1.0.1 was published on Zenodo in November 2019 by Iver Bakken Sperstad, Espen Hafstad Solvang and Sigurd Hofsmo Jakobsen, with a README describing each file. Bus, generator, branch, generator cost and area tables follow the MATPOWER case format, and a PSS/E .sav file is included. Operating states represent each month of the year plus 24 hours of a representative week, with generation and load for each state and an interruption cost per bus for load shedding in optimal power flow. Outage data, protection and control data, relative component failure rates and outage durations, and relative customer loads support reliability analysis. Coverage is a synthetic network not tied to a place. Files are CSV tables, a PSS/E case and a README, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the case is small and synthetic, and it matches one of several published variants. Simulation uses are reliability of supply assessment, contingency and protection failure analysis and outage cost estimation. Related records: data-rts-gmlc is another reliability test system.
